PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3id.org/brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?sensor ?pointref ?seriesid ?pointclass WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?zlabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?zlabel, "Perimeter_mid_ZN_4"))
  ?sensor a brick:Electric_Power_Sensor ; brick:hasInput ?zone .
  ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference ?pointref .
  ?pointref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?seriesid .
  OPTIONAL { ?pointref a ?pointclass . }
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>

SELECT ?z ?zlabel WHERE {
  ?z a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?zlabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(str(?zlabel), "Perimeter"))
}

SELECT ?s ?p WHERE { ?s rdfs:label ?p } LIMIT 50
